newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-SEASON-ENDING ELBOW SURGERY FOR ANGELS' VELARDE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-SEASON-ENDING ELBOW SURGERY FOR ANGELS' VELARDE.

text.p: The season is over before it began for Anaheim Angels infielder Randy Velarde.
The team said Wednesday that Verarde was scheduled to undergo season-ending elbow surgery next week.
Team medical director Dr Lewis Yocum will perform the surgery to repair a torn right ulnar collateral ligament.
Velarde, 34, has been on the disabled list since injuring his elbow while tossing in the outfield March 9.
He signed with the Angels as a free agent last year after nine seasons with the New York Yankees and hit .285 while posting career highs with 14 homers and 54 RBI.
